# Tables

Each table of addresses, jumps and words, entry by entry. An RTS table holds each target minus 1; the target column gives the target. Index: [the reference](index.md).

<a id="actor_frame_addr_lo"></a>
## [`actor_frame_addr_lo`](../../src/actor_room_tables.asm#L9) `$1167-$130A`

*addresses-split*

Low bytes of 210 addresses of 96-byte actor graphics frames (three 32-byte columns) that $512F builds at init in $9000-$9FBF and $C000-$CADF. Odd entries name the overlay frame: $CAE0 is the scratch frame ORed onto the even frame before it, high byte 0 means no overlay.

- **Read by:** [`build_collision_masks`](modules/collision.md#build_collision_masks) [`$513F`](../../src/collision.asm#L30), [`build_collision_masks`](modules/collision.md#build_collision_masks) [`$515D`](../../src/collision.asm#L46), [`build_collision_masks`](modules/collision.md#build_collision_masks) [`$5162`](../../src/collision.asm#L48), [`build_frame_mask`](modules/collision.md#build_frame_mask) [`$518E`](../../src/collision.asm#L72), [`build_frame_mask`](modules/collision.md#build_frame_mask) [`$5193`](../../src/collision.asm#L74), [`actor_background_collision`](modules/collision.md#actor_background_collision) [`$5239`](../../src/collision.asm#L172), [`actor_background_collision`](modules/collision.md#actor_background_collision) [`$523F`](../../src/collision.asm#L174)

<a id="message_pointers"></a>
## [`message_pointers`](../../src/messages.asm#L6) `$43BE-$4487`

*addresses*

Message table: 101 pointers (messages 0-100) for print_message ($17E2: A = message, X = text row, Y = column offset). A message ends with $A0. Byte b gives char (b-$20) AND $7F in the top row and (b-$20) OR $80 in the bottom row, so bit 7 of b has no effect. Text messages are ASCII for the charset at $8800; tile strings are room tile numbers + $20.
Word table of message text addresses for print_message.

- **Read by:** [`print_message`](modules/text.md#print_message) [`$17EB`](../../src/text.asm#L13), [`print_message`](modules/text.md#print_message) [`$17F3`](../../src/text.asm#L17)

<a id="room_atari_colour_ptrs"></a>
## [`room_atari_colour_ptrs`](../../src/room_tables.asm#L86) `$4AA8-$4ACF`

*addresses*

Per room (20 words): pointer to 20 bytes (4 records of 5) that draw_room copies to raster_colours $0153-$0166 ($0A87). irq_frame_top overwrites $0153-$015E every frame; $015F-$0166 are read only by save_raster_colours (screen saver). Rooms share the pointers in the same groups as room_split_colour_ptrs, and the values fit the Atari 8-bit colour format: treated as a leftover of the Atari version. Room 19's 20 bytes run into room_map_ptrs_lo.

- **Read by:** [`draw_room`](modules/room_draw.md#draw_room) [`$0A87`](../../src/room_draw.asm#L111), [`draw_room`](modules/room_draw.md#draw_room) [`$0A8C`](../../src/room_draw.asm#L113)

## [`frame_src_lo`](../../src/sprite_data.asm#L43) `$59BD-$5B60`

*addresses-split*

Frame graphics pointers, 210 low bytes then 210 high bytes; 0 = no graphics. Frames 0-69 Bruce Lee, 70-139 Yamo, 140-209 Ninja; frames f and f+1 (f even) are the two sprite layers of one picture.
